---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a feature or improvement for TmuxGo / 建议新功能或改进
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
---

## 场景 / Problem

想解决什么问题、当前哪里不便。/ What problem this solves and what is inconvenient today.

## 期望方案 / Proposal

希望的行为或交互方式。/ The behavior or UX you want.

## 备选方案 / Alternatives

考虑过的其他做法及取舍。/ Other approaches considered and trade-offs.

## 边界说明 / Scope note

TmuxGo 定位个人自托管、单管理身份；多账号/RBAC 类需求请先说明威胁模型与使用场景。
TmuxGo targets self-hosted single-admin use; multi-account/RBAC requests should state the threat model and use case first.
